common.linkFallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.intro: Thank you for signing up for Umoja Jobs. Please confirm your email address to activate your account.
verifyEmail.ignore: If you did not sign up, you can safely ignore this email.

accountExists.subject: Sign-up attempt with your email address
accountExists.intro: Someone tried to sign up with your email address, but an Umoja Jobs account already exists for it.
accountExists.hint: If this was you, please sign in. If you forgot your password, you can reset it.
accountExists.ignore: If this was not you, no action is needed: your account has not been changed.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password
passwordReset.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your account.
passwordReset.expiry: This link expires in {minutes} minutes and can only be used once.
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not request this, ignore this email: your password remains unchanged.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password has been changed
passwordChanged.intro: The password for your Umoja Jobs account has just been changed. For your security, your other sessions have been signed out.
passwordChanged.warning: If you did not make this change, reset your password immediately and contact our support team.
